d:
Bihar ki rajniti men anant sinh aur jediyu emaelsi niraj kumar ke bich talkhi kisi se chhipi nahin hai. is bich anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki shadi ko lekar niraj kumar ne unhen aashirvad diya hai. shivangi ko shubhkamnaen dete hue niraj kumar ne kaha ki hamare parivar ko vo jo kahen, ham to sabki betiyon ko aashirvad hi dete hain. emaelsi chunav men anant sinh ne niraj kumar ka virodh kiya tha. aise men niraj kumar ka yah bayan siyasi charcha men hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
